Summary: The promises of God are His sworn commitments scattered through Scripture - hundreds of them, covering provision, presence, forgiveness, guidance, and eternal life. Christians read them as a family inheritance: every promise finds its yes in Christ, and each one invites trust in a specific situation. The discipline is to claim promises as God gave them, without twisting them into guarantees He never made or ignoring the conditions He attached.
KeyPassages: Genesis 28:15; Deuteronomy 31:6; Isaiah 41:10; Matthew 28:20; Romans 8:28; Hebrews 13:5-6
RelatedBooks: Genesis; Deuteronomy; Isaiah; Matthew; Romans; Hebrews
